characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value:
Multinational, multicentre, controlled, open-label, randomized, parallel-group, comparative clinical trial

Randomisation ratio: 1:1

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Adults with Type 1 diabetes, recruited at 62 investigational sites in 13 European countries and 5 sites in South Africa (total: 67 sites)

Inclusion criteria: Men and women aged ≥18 years; diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes (onset <40 years, continuous insulin therapy since diagnosis and >1 year prior to study); HbA1c 6.0–11.0%; BMI <35 kg/m²; able and willing to perform blood glucose monitoring

Exclusion criteria: Active proliferative/unstable diabetic retinopathy in last 6 months; impaired hepatic or renal function; history of seizures or hypersensitivity to insulin/excipients

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Number of study centres: 67 (62 in Europe, 5 in South Africa)

Treatment before study: Basal-bolus insulin regimen

Run-in period: 4 weeks (prior screening 1 week; run-in 4 weeks with mealtime lispro and evening glargine)

Treatment period: 26 weeks

insulin glulisine vs insulin lispro

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
Primary outcome: Change from baseline in HbA1c (glycated hemoglobin) from baseline to endpoint (week 26)

Secondary outcomes: Proportion of patients reaching target HbA1c categories (≤7.0%, ≤8.0%, reduction ≥0.7%); Changes in self-monitored 7-point blood glucose profile (pre- and postprandial for all meals, bedtime, and nighttime); Changes in insulin dose (rapid-acting and basal) from baseline to endpoint; Rate of symptomatic, severe, and nocturnal hypoglycaemia (events per patient-month); Adverse events (treatment-emergent, serious, injection site, systemic hypersensitivity reactions); Laboratory data: haematology, clinical chemistry, lipids, insulin antibodies, Escherichia coli protein antibodies;

characteristics.value:

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value:
randomized, multinational, parallel group, treat-to-target study 

Randomisation ratio: 4:4:3

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Inclusion criteria: participants with type 1 diabetes, aged ≥ 18 years, continuously using insulin for ≥ 1 year; treated with a rapid-acting insulin analogue ≥ 90 days and basal insulin ≥ 30 days prior to screening; had an HbA1c of 53.0-80.3mmol/mol (7.0-9.5%), and a BMI ≤ 35kg/m2

Exclusion criteria: hypoglycaemia unawareness, more than one episode of severe hypoglycaemia requiring assistance, o poor glucose control requiring emergency room visit or hospitalization int 6 months prior to screening 

N= 1222 (n mealtime URLi= 451, n lispro= 442, n postmeal URLi= 329)
